nodes.label: HospitALL Frontend Public Favicon/Logo
nodes.description: Public-facing favicon/logo for the HospitALL React web app. Brand mark depicts a teal/blue shield containing a stack of medical folders/documents (with a gear icon and a heart-marked clipboard), overlaid with a prominent medical cross and a stethoscope curling around the right side. Color palette is a teal-to-deep-blue gradient (cyan/teal transitioning to navy) on a transparent background. Glyphs: shield (security/protection), medical cross (healthcare), folder stack (records management), heart on clipboard (patient care), stethoscope (clinical), gear (settings/management). Communicates secure hospital records management.

nodes.label: HospitALL Frontend Logo Asset (Logo.jpeg)
nodes.description: React-bundled brand logo for HospitALL. Composition: a navy/teal shield emblem centered above a two-line wordmark. Inside the shield, a stylized blue medical folder with a white medical cross overlays a stack of clinical documents (one shows a heart-icon clipboard, one a gear/settings icon, plus a stethoscope curl on the right). Palette: dark navy, mid blue, teal/cyan accent, with white negative space for the cross and document highlights, on an off-white/cream background. Typography: bold uppercase 'HOSPITAL RECORD' in navy on top line, 'MANAGEMENT' in mid-blue below, separated from the shield by a thin teal divider rule.
